note: Structural role map for the aircraft damage model. It maps a game hit point name to one AEE system role. The structure is learned from the HeliSim component model (the bmkhsRole property in hitPoints.hpp), not copied. This file is a structural artefact. It carries no grade and no hit point armour value. It is not sourced data. A role is one of the tokens in the roles list. The consumer is the scripted damage layer (addons/mobility/functions/fnc_updateDamageSystem.sqf).
